Senior Mechanical Engineer — Product Design
Company: Precision Manufacturing Corp
Location: Detroit, MI
Type: Full-time

About the Role:
We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead our product design and prototyping team. You will design mechanical systems, run FEA simulations, and oversee manufacturing processes.

Responsibilities:
- Design mechanical components and assemblies using SolidWorks and CATIA
- Perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations
- Create detailed engineering drawings with GD&T specifications
- Lead design reviews and DFMEA/PFMEA processes
- Select materials based on strength, weight, and cost requirements
- Coordinate with manufacturing team on CNC machining, injection molding, and 3D printing
- Develop and execute test plans for mechanical validation
- Manage relationships with component suppliers
- Mentor junior mechanical engineers
- Ensure compliance with ASME, ISO, and industry-specific standards

Required Skills:
- 7+ years of mechanical design experience in manufacturing
- Expert proficiency in SolidWorks or CATIA V5
- Strong experience with FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, or SolidWorks Simulation)
- Deep knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5)
- Experience with CNC machining and injection molding processes
- Strong understanding of materials science (metals, polymers, composites)
- Experience with product lifecycle management (PLM) systems
- Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering

Preferred Skills:
- CFD simulation experience
- Knowledge of additive manufacturing / 3D printing
- Six Sigma certification (Green or Black Belt)
- Experience with DFMEA/PFMEA methodologies
- Patent authorship experience
